pages.title: Galaxy Shoot
pages.creator: HyperJoy
pages.description: Time each shot in Galaxy Shoot, where the turret at the center spins automatically and the targets orbit around it. Watch the direction of the barrel and the path of the next target together. Fire when their paths line up, then get ready to judge a new angle for the next shot.

pages.title: Happy Fox
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Slide pieces into matches in Happy Fox and collect the items each level asks for. Check the goal before you move so your matches count toward the right targets. Work within a move limit or play against the clock, and aim for three stars as you learn to get more out of each slide.

pages.title: Mahjong Match Line
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Slide tiles horizontally or vertically in Mahjong Match Line to bring identical designs together. Matching tiles merge, making room on the board for your next moves. Look at which pairs you can reach now and which ones need more space, then keep working until the board is clear.

pages.title: Color Path Puzzle
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Move shapes off the board in Color Path Puzzle. Each piece can travel through areas of its own color, so trace the available route before you start sliding it. Work out which shape should go first when pieces are in each other’s way and clear the field to complete the level.

pages.title: Rope Stitch Puzzle
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description: Follow the numbered clues in Rope Stitch Puzzle to connect dots with colored rope. Each number tells you how many dots belong in that segment. Drag the rope between them and build up the shapes one section at a time until the hidden picture is complete.

pages.title: Valentines Hidden Alphawords
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Search for hidden letters in Valentines Hidden Alphawords. Find them in romantic scenes to uncover a caption that goes with each picture. There are 30 levels, and the timer keeps running while you search. Use a hint if a letter keeps escaping your notice.

pages.title: Basket Swap
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Get the ball and basket into position in Basket Swap. Use the gray blocks to stop or line up your slides as you work through the board. If a move leaves you stuck, use the arrow in the lower left to undo it, or press R to start the level again.

pages.title: Labubu Coloring Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pick a picture of Labubu and friends in Labubu Coloring Adventure. Choose colors for the characters, then fill in the details around them to give each scene a different look. Switch to another page when you want a new expression or background to color.

pages.title: CrazyZombies 3D
pages.creator: Devshifu Studio
pages.description: Fight off waves of undead enemies in CrazyZombies 3D, a top-down shooter set in a town. Build a loadout from more than ten weapons and use upgrades to prepare for tougher encounters. Five kinds of zombies and four bosses give you different threats to handle as the run goes on.

pages.title: Summer Maze
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Roll a ball through the corridors in Summer Maze until you’ve covered every part of the maze. Look for unfilled branches and work out how to reach them before you finish the level. Collect gems as you play and put them toward a new look for the ball.

pages.title: Rootlings: Secrets of the Depths
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Guide a root underground one turn at a time in Rootlings: Secrets of the Depths. Collect water to stay alive and choose a path around hazards. Play through set challenges or try the endless mode to see how deep you can go on the leaderboard, and customize your root with hats.

pages.title: Save the crop
pages.creator: Alonesher Productions
pages.description: Drive a tractor through burning fields in Save the crop and cut the plants before the flames reach them. Gather and stack what you save, then sell it for money. Spend the proceeds on tractor upgrades or storage and move on to explore new fields.

pages.title: Tricky Castle
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Help a knight escape a medieval stronghold in Tricky Castle. Get past traps and solve the puzzle in each room to move on. Check the layout for clues before jumping, because the way out can depend on working out what the room is asking you to do.

pages.title: Bloom Sort 2: Bee Puzzle
pages.creator: Mad Pixel Games LTD
pages.description: Place flowers next to each other in Bloom Sort 2: Bee Puzzle so they can exchange petals of matching colors. Complete a flower to clear it from the board and free space for the next one. Look at the colors on neighboring flowers before you decide where to place a new piece.

pages.title: Solitaire Winter
pages.creator: Mad Data
pages.description: Rebuild five winter locations by playing through 200 levels in Solitaire Winter. Work around frozen cards, locks, chains, and vines to collect coins and gems for shop upgrades. Aim for three stars on the main levels and unlock 18 bonus solitaire variants, including Klondike, Spider, and Freecell.

pages.title: 2048 Number Match
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Connect numbered tiles in 2048 Number Match to build higher values. Look for matching numbers or the next value in the sequence as you extend a chain. Use power-ups when you need help getting a combination started, then keep going to see how high you can score.

pages.title: Octonauts Bubbles
pages.creator: Tap Tap Tales
pages.description: Join Captain Barnacles, Peso, and Kwazii on an underwater rescue in Octonauts Bubbles. Match three identical Octonauts badges to clear them, then remove the remaining badges to finish the level. Guide the GUP-A through the puzzles on the way to the whale shark and help the team reach Dashi.

pages.title: 2048 Cube Shooting Merge
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Shoot numbered cubes into a 3D play area in 2048 Cube Shooting Merge. Send a cube toward another with the same number to make a higher value. The cubes can bounce and shift after a collision, so check where they settle before deciding where to aim the next shot.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Pro 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match three or more bubbles of the same color in Bubble Shooter Pro 3. Check the next bubble before choosing where to aim, and use the fireball when it appears to break through any color. Try different difficulties to earn achievements and see where your score lands on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Ball Up 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Race an opponent to the finish in Ball Up 3D. Time your moves as the ball rises, and stay clear of bombs and obstacles. Look out for mystery boxes as you go, since collecting one can help you get ahead of the other player before the finish.

pages.title: Perfect Prom Night Look
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Style Anna, Elsa, Ariel, Moana, Jasmine, and Snow White for prom in Perfect Prom Night Look. Choose an outfit for each princess and look through the accessories to find pieces that go with it. Try different combinations so each of the six has her own look for the event.

pages.title: Archery Master
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Take aim at targets in Archery Master. Check the wind before you release, because it can change where the arrow lands. Aim for the center and meet the level’s target to advance, then adjust your shots for the conditions in the next archery challenge.

pages.title: Off Road Auto Trial
pages.creator: ivadoGames
pages.description: Pick a vehicle and drive through rough terrain in Off Road Auto Trial. Work your way past obstacles and pick up rewards as you cross deserts, coastal courses, and Arctic terrain. Check your car’s characteristics in the garage and upgrade it before heading into another course.

pages.title: Block Puzzle Jewel
pages.creator: AGED STUDIO LIMITED
pages.description: Fit gem pieces into a 9-by-9 board in Block Puzzle Jewel. Complete a row, column, or 3-by-3 square to clear it, and aim for more than one clear at a time to earn extra points. Use the storage slot when a piece would fit better later.

pages.title: Xmas Hidden Objects
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find the items shown on the left of the screen in Xmas Hidden Objects. Look for each one among the decorations and details in the scene, then click or tap it when you spot it. Finish the search before the timer runs out to earn bonus points.

pages.title: Honey pickers
pages.creator: happyGames
pages.description: Raise bees and collect their honey in Honey pickers. Sell the honey for money, then decide whether to upgrade your bees or spend it on equipment. Keep collecting and selling as you build up the operation and put each round of earnings back into the hive.

pages.title: Color Galaxy
pages.creator: Gismart
pages.description: Draw a trail across the map in Color Galaxy, then loop back to your own color to claim the area you’ve enclosed. Rivals can cut your trail while you’re outside your territory. Decide how far to venture before returning, and watch for a chance to take over more ground.

pages.title: Baby Tailor Clothes and Shoes Maker
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Make clothes for customers in Baby Tailor Clothes and Shoes Maker. Pick a fabric, cut it to match your design, then stitch it on the sewing machine. Try different buttons or stickers to finish the garment before you start on another design.

pages.title: Noob vs Blue Monster
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Help Noob get away from a huge blue monster in Noob vs Blue Monster. Cross the cliffs and keep moving as the creature chases you. Watch for the next place to land and make it to the statue portal at the end to escape.

pages.title: Running Girl 3D
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Collect wooden boards as you race in Running Girl 3D. Use them to cross water and cut across parts of the course to get ahead. Decide where a shortcut is worth taking, and pick up diamonds as you run to unlock more skins after the race.

pages.title: Spartan Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Match pairs of Spartan-themed tiles in Spartan Mahjong. A tile needs an open left or right side before you can use it, so remove pairs that free up others. Try to finish before time runs out, with bonus points for time saved and hints left unused.

pages.title: Tennis Open 2022
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Practice in training mode before entering a tournament in Tennis Open 2022. Return the ball and work the rally until you can get a shot past your opponent. Use rewards from matches to improve your player as you advance through the competition.

pages.title: Demon Raid 2
pages.creator: Booblyc OU
pages.description: Defend the kingdom from an invasion in Demon Raid 2. Place archers, knights, and sorcerers where they can intercept enemies along the road. Join Targa Wrathbringer and his allies, then spend diamonds on their skill trees to improve the abilities you’ll need in later battles.

pages.title: Fire vs Water Fights
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Pick a fire or water fighter and trade punches in Fire vs Water Fights. Watch for an opening before spending your Super Punch, and try to win two rounds in a row. Take on the computer in single-player mode or face a friend in a two-player fight.

pages.title: Princesses Funky Style
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Choose outfits for Mia, Emma, Clara, and Sophie in Princesses Funky Style. Explore the clothes available for each princess and put together four looks inspired by the game’s funky fashion theme. Try different pieces side by side before deciding how you want each princess to dress.

pages.title: LinQuest
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Guide adventurer Lin through three dangerous zones in LinQuest. Move across platforms and work your way around hazards as you search for a mysterious treasure. Watch the ground ahead before committing to a jump and keep going through each area to see where the search leads.

pages.title: Drop n Merge
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Drop numbered blocks onto the board in Drop n Merge. Aim for a spot beside a block with the same value so they can combine into a higher number. Leave room for the next drop as the board fills up. There’s no timer, so you can compare placements before you commit.

pages.title: Pichon: The Bouncy Bird
pages.creator: Red Mage Games
pages.description: Steer a bird that never stops bouncing in Pichon: The Bouncy Bird. Time your landings on surfaces that change the height or speed of a bounce, and watch for blocks that crumble. Activate special blocks to open passages and collect the gems needed to unlock each exit.

pages.title: My Pony Designer
pages.creator: IG
pages.description: Build a pony from scratch in My Pony Designer. Choose its head, body, tail, and wings, then change the colors and pick a garment. Add stickers once the main design is ready, and use the photo option to download an image of the pony you made.

pages.title: Crazy Professor Princess Maker
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create a character inspired by Rick and Morty in Crazy Professor Princess Maker. Choose a hairstyle and facial features, then try modern clothes or a princess dress in colors you pick. Finish the design with accessories and a background that suits the character you’ve put together.

pages.title: Sweet Baby Girl Halloween Fun
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Get ready for Halloween in Sweet Baby Girl Halloween Fun. Carve a pumpkin and decorate the house with jack-o’-lanterns, bats, and ghosts. Then choose a witch costume or mix pieces from different outfits, and finish the look with vampire makeup if you want a scarier style.

pages.title: Math Speed Racing Rounding 10
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Keep your car fueled in Math Speed Racing Rounding 10. Round the number on the car to the nearest ten and steer over the fuel can that shows the answer. Pick up coins for points while avoiding other cars, and see how far you can drive before a crash or an empty tank.

pages.title: Airplanes Coloring Pages
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Choose from 16 aircraft pictures in Airplanes Coloring Pages. Use the 23-color palette to fill in each illustration, and work quickly if you want to improve your score. When you’re happy with how a picture looks, save a copy and pick another airplane to color.

pages.title: Animal Fashion Hair Salon
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Give jungle animals new hairstyles in Animal Fashion Hair Salon. Choose an animal, then use the salon tools to change the way its hair looks. Try a different cut or style on each client and see how the makeover changes its appearance.

pages.title: Roller Splat!
pages.creator: GameBake Ltd
pages.description: Swipe to send a paintball down the corridors in Roller Splat! The ball leaves color wherever it rolls, so plan how to reach any strips you’ve missed. Fill every corridor and corner of the maze with paint to finish the puzzle and move on to another layout.

pages.title: Real BiCycle Racing Game 3D
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Ride a bicycle through a city racing championship in Real BiCycle Racing Game 3D. Follow the streets and steer as the route changes, keeping the bike pointed down the course. Carry your speed through the stretches where you have room and adjust as you approach a turn.

pages.title: Super Plumber
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Repair an urban water supply in Super Plumber. Look at the broken run of pipes and work out how to reconnect it so water can flow. Check each joint as you rebuild the route, since a gap anywhere along the line can keep the system from working.

pages.title: Into The Dead Trigger
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fight through a zombie outbreak in Into The Dead Trigger. Move around the area, raise your sights, and fire as the undead come after you. Reload before you need another shot, or use a grenade when several zombies are close enough to catch in the blast.

pages.title: Hero Mask Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Turn over tiles to find pairs of matching hero masks in Hero Mask Memory. Remember where a mask is hiding so you can find it again when its partner appears. Clear all the pairs in each of the four levels and try to do it in fewer moves.

pages.title: Amaze!!!
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Color the play area by rolling a ball through it in Amaze!!!. Follow the paths and look for spaces you haven’t painted yet, then work out how to bring the ball back to them. Cover the entire layout to complete the puzzle.

pages.title: Kara Sky Jump
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Help a flightless chicken climb into the sky in Kara Sky Jump. Land on the floating platforms one after another, watching for ones that move before you commit to a jump. The higher you climb, the more you score, but a fall ends the attempt.

pages.title: Toilet Rush 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Get the stickman to the bathroom before time runs out in Toilet Rush 2. Rush through the obstacles and reach the toilet at the end of each level. Some stages are dark or have invisible elements, so remember the route when you can’t see everything ahead.

pages.title: Real Dog Racing Simulator Game 2020
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Race a greyhound against other dogs in Real Dog Racing Simulator Game 2020. Tap the Up arrow repeatedly to keep your dog running and gain ground on the field. Watch your position as the pack heads down the track and keep up the pace to the finish.

pages.title: Ambulance Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide tiles into place to rebuild an ambulance picture in Ambulance Slide. Choose from three images and three puzzle modes, then look for parts of the vehicle that line up across neighboring tiles. Work the pieces into position until the original picture is whole again.

pages.title: Police MotorBike Race Simulator 3D
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Take a police motorcycle onto the highway in Police MotorBike Race Simulator 3D. Choose a bike, build up speed, and try jumps and freestyle stunts as you ride among other bikers. Switch motorcycles to take another one out on the road and see how it handles.

pages.title: Xmas Sudoku
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Fill the empty squares with holiday items in Xmas Sudoku. Check each row and column before placing a piece, because you can’t use the same item twice in either one. Start another round for a new puzzle once you’ve filled the board.

pages.title: Impossible Sports Car Simulator 3D
pages.creator: Thumb Game Studio
pages.description: Drive a sports car along elevated tracks in Impossible Sports Car Simulator 3D. Work around the hurdles without slipping off the edge, and keep the car lined up as the route changes. Adjust your speed before the next obstacle so you have room to steer around it.

pages.title: Metal Guns Fury : beat em up
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Take back an island with a four-soldier commando squad in Metal Guns Fury : beat em up. Choose a soldier and fight through the invading forces with the weapons available to you. Use vehicles such as tanks and mechs when you need more firepower in the battle.

pages.title: Powerslide Kart Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive across three maps in Powerslide Kart Simulator and try out three different vehicles. Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer and hold Shift for a boost. The Space bar handles drifts and jumps, so you can practice both as you explore the courses.

pages.title: ABCs of Halloween
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together six Halloween pictures in ABCs of Halloween. Pick a scene and choose a 16-, 36-, 64-, or 100-piece layout. Look for the edge pieces first or start with a detail you recognize, then build around it until the picture is complete.

pages.title: Defend Village
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Build defenses along the road in Defend Village before the monsters reach their destination. Choose where to place towers so they can attack the approaching enemies as they move toward the village. Watch the path and cover stretches where the monsters might otherwise get through.

pages.title: Hill Climb Driving
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Pick up passengers and deliver them before time runs out in Hill Climb Driving. Follow the route through the hills and steer around obstacles on the way. Keep track of the clock while you drive so each passenger reaches the right destination in time.

pages.title: Roadster BC Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble six pictures of the Roadster BC in Roadster BC Puzzle. Choose between 16, 36, 64, and 100 pieces for each photograph. Use the car’s bodywork and the details behind it to find where pieces join, then try the same image with a finer cut.

pages.title: Monster 4x4 Offroad Jeep Stunt Racing 2019
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take a 4x4 or 6x6 jeep onto mountain tracks in Monster 4x4 Offroad Jeep Stunt Racing 2019. Climb the off-road routes and keep control of the vehicle as the ground changes under the wheels. Try the different jeeps as you work through the stunt-driving courses.

pages.title: Dino Transport Truck
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive a dinosaur carrier in Dino Transport Truck. Load up your prehistoric cargo and follow the route to the delivery point, watching for dinosaurs that wander near the truck. Try the three game modes and work through the different transport levels.

pages.title: Cat Gunner vs Zombies
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Defend a city of cats from a zombie outbreak in Cat Gunner vs Zombies. Play as a member of the agent team and fire at infected cats as they come in waves. Clear the attackers from each area and see how many levels you can survive.

pages.title: Knife Up
pages.creator: 8Fat.com
pages.description: Send a knife upward in Knife Up. Tap to make it jump and time each tap as you work your way higher. Keep the climb going to add to your score, and try another run to see whether you can get farther.

pages.title: Sand Drawing
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Draw in sand in Sand Drawing. Pick a surface texture, then trace marks and patterns directly on it. Try a different type of sand to change the look of your drawing, or make a fresh design with the same surface.

pages.title: My Pony My Little Race
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Race a pony through meadows and mountain scenery in My Pony My Little Race. Speed up along clear stretches and time your jumps to get past obstacles. The courses get harder as you go, so watch for what’s coming before you decide when to jump.

pages.title: EG Big Snake
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Steer a growing snake in EG Big Snake. Move toward food to build up its length and watch the other snakes as they cross your path. You can steer with the on-screen joystick, the arrow keys, or WASD, depending on how you want to play.

pages.title: Race Down
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Drive down a stack of platforms in Race Down. Stay on the platforms as you look for gaps that let you move lower, and collect coins along the way. Keep the car between the top and bottom edges of the screen, because reaching either one ends the run.

pages.title: Brain 100
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Remember which tiles show a cat in Brain 100. Study their positions before the pictures are covered, then pick out the tiles from memory. Start with a 3-by-3 board and try the larger 4-by-4, 5-by-5, or 6-by-6 layouts when you’re ready for more positions to remember.

pages.title: Rome Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take up a weapon and fight across two maps in Rome Simulator. Try different weapons to see how they handle and use the shield to block incoming attacks. Watch your opponent’s movement before you swing, then look for a chance to strike when their guard opens.

pages.title: Hero In Super Action Adventure
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Fight enemies and collect coins in Hero In Super Action Adventure. Watch where the next enemies are coming from and deal with them while picking up coins along the way. Try to collect as many as you can while you fight through the adventure.

pages.title: Jenner Sisters Matching Monster High
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Kendall and Kylie find hidden dolls in Jenner Sisters Matching Monster High. Search their room before choosing a Monster High doll for each sister. Then use the dolls’ clothes as a guide while you dress the sisters in matching outfits.

pages.title: Trixology
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Rotate falling pieces to fill the grid in Trixology. Complete a row without gaps to clear it and earn points, then make use of the space that opens up. Adjust the fall speed or rotate either way to fit the pieces as the levels get harder.

pages.title: Crazy Archer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pop every balloon in Crazy Archer to finish each of its 22 levels. Line up your shots and watch where the arrows land before adjusting your aim. Look for angles that give you a clear path to the balloons still on the board.

pages.title: Princess VS Mermaid Outfit
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help a princess choose her look for a summer event in Princess VS Mermaid Outfit. Try clothes for a royal outfit and explore the mermaid styles before making your choice. Put together the pieces you like and see which look suits the occasion.

pages.title: Tower Defense Super Heroes
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Place villains along a path to stop approaching heroes in Tower Defense Super Heroes. Each defender has different characteristics, so pick positions that make use of what they can do. Every hero who gets past your team costs health, so watch the route for openings in your defenses.

pages.title: Fun Girls Night
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Join Aurora, Rapunzel, and Ariel for a party in Fun Girls Night. Play through the challenges the friends have lined up, then try makeup, clothes, and accessories in the makeover activities. Pick the details you want for their looks as you work through the evening.

pages.title: Neon Dunk
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: Guide a basketball through neon hoops in Neon Dunk. Keep clear of spikes, collect stars, and try to go through the rings cleanly for a bigger bonus. Missing a hoop puts the run at risk, so keep looking toward the next one while working up your score and earning new balls.

pages.title: FLAMMY
pages.creator: wopa interactive
pages.description: Help Flammy climb out of a volcano in FLAMMY. Collect gems to build up power for the obstacles that appear on the way out. The route gets more difficult as your score rises, so keep watching for the next gap and pick up gems when you can reach them.

pages.title: Tweety Fly
pages.creator: Numidia Studio
pages.description: Help a little bird fly through obstacle courses in Tweety Fly. Time your flaps to stay clear of hazards and reach the coins along the way. Watch what’s coming up while you fly, then adjust your height to find a route through the next section.

pages.title: Pong vs Bumpers
pages.creator: ESERGAMES
pages.description: Bounce a ball around the board in Pong vs Bumpers. Move the paddle to keep the ball in play and send it toward the red bumpers. Turn them green to finish the level, and watch where each rebound goes so you can get the paddle under it in time.

pages.title: Planet Of Kaz
pages.creator: littlegiantworld
pages.description: Fight creatures from Kaz in Planet Of Kaz. Play as a warrior from Earth sent to recover the energy the invaders absorbed. Take on the creatures and extract that energy as you work through the mission to help restore what Earth lost during the invasion.

pages.title: Super Pineapple Pen 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Throw pens at apples and pineapples in Super Pineapple Pen 2. Time your shot to land on the fruit without hitting a pen that’s already stuck there. Collect coins and spend them on different objects to throw as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Saga of Kraigen: Ambush at the Dragon Pa
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Take up a sword in Saga of Kraigen: Ambush at the Dragon Pa. Face the enemies coming after the warrior and time each swing when a target comes within reach. Keep fighting through the ambush and see how far you can get.

pages.title: Candy Prom Night
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Choose dresses for a prom in Candy Prom Night. Try outfits on the girls, then add details such as a bag, jewelry, or a sparkling crown. Give each girl her own combination and see how the accessories change the look of the dress.

pages.title: Descendants Dress Up
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style Evie, Jay, Carlos, and Mal in Descendants Dress Up. The four characters are leaving the Isle of the Lost for a new life, and you get to choose how they dress. Try different clothes and accessories to give each of them a look for the change of scene.
